# IA policy / procedure package - text bundle part 2 of 4 (RCAI&A)
# Unpack: put all parts in one folder and run tools/unpack_bundle.py or the unpack cell in README section 6.
# Do not edit by hand: every file carries a sha256 check.
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/compare.py | sha256=58561fcf343a8e735ef553f21efb5fce634dca737e4432058a526fc251fef448 ####
"""Compare two runs (e.g. the validated notebook run and this package on the same 10 alerts).

python -m ia_pp compare --run-a <notebook output folder> --run-b <package output folder> [--alert-ids 1,2,3]

Writes compare_report.xlsx (or CSVs if openpyxl is missing) in run B's folder and prints the agreement.
Expect small differences: the model does not answer identically twice (about 10% of links flip between two runs
of the same prompt), and procedures differ if the shortlist was rebuilt (use run.reuse_search_from to share it).
"""
import os

import pandas as pd

KEYS = ["RECORD_ID", "DOC_ID"]
LINKISH = ["IMPACTED", "POSSIBLE_IMPACT", "SCOPE_REVIEW"]


def _load(folder):
    p = os.path.join(folder, "ia_pp_pairs.parquet")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"{p} not found - run the results stage there first")
    df = pd.read_parquet(p)
    df["RECORD_ID"] = df["RECORD_ID"].astype(str)
    return df


def compare(run_a, run_b, alert_ids=None, out_dir=None):
    A, B = _load(run_a), _load(run_b)
    common = sorted(set(A.RECORD_ID) & set(B.RECORD_ID))
    if alert_ids:
        common = [a for a in common if a in {str(x) for x in alert_ids}]
    if not common:
        raise ValueError("no alert in common between the two runs")
    A, B = A[A.RECORD_ID.isin(common)], B[B.RECORD_ID.isin(common)]
    cols = ["DOC_TYPE", "impact_status", "link_score", "final_decision", "linked_sections"]
    m = A[KEYS + cols].merge(B[KEYS + cols], on=KEYS, how="outer", suffixes=("_a", "_b"), indicator=True)
    m["DOC_TYPE"] = m.DOC_TYPE_a.fillna(m.DOC_TYPE_b)
    both = m[m._merge == "both"].copy()
    both["same_status"] = both.impact_status_a == both.impact_status_b
    both["linked_a"] = both.impact_status_a.isin(LINKISH)
    both["linked_b"] = both.impact_status_b.isin(LINKISH)
    rows = []
    for t, g in both.groupby("DOC_TYPE"):
        la, lb = int(g.linked_a.sum()), int(g.linked_b.sum())
        inter = int((g.linked_a & g.linked_b).sum())
        rows.append(dict(doc_type=t, pairs_in_both=len(g), same_status_pct=round(100 * g.same_status.mean(), 1),
                         linked_a=la, linked_b=lb, linked_in_both=inter,
                         link_overlap_pct=round(100 * inter / max(la + lb - inter, 1), 1),
                         impacted_a=int((g.impact_status_a == "IMPACTED").sum()),
                         impacted_b=int((g.impact_status_b == "IMPACTED").sum()),
                         only_in_a=int(((m._merge == "left_only") & (m.DOC_TYPE == t)).sum()),
                         only_in_b=int(((m._merge == "right_only") & (m.DOC_TYPE == t)).sum())))
    summary = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    per_alert = both.groupby(["RECORD_ID", "DOC_TYPE"]).agg(linked_a=("linked_a", "sum"), linked_b=("linked_b", "sum"),
                                                           same_status_pct=("same_status", "mean")).reset_index()
    per_alert["same_status_pct"] = (100 * per_alert.same_status_pct).round(1)
    diffs = both[~both.same_status].sort_values(["RECORD_ID", "DOC_TYPE", "DOC_ID"])
    out_dir = out_dir or run_b
    try:
        with pd.ExcelWriter(os.path.join(out_dir, "compare_report.xlsx")) as xl:
            pd.DataFrame({"How to read": [
                f"Run A: {run_a}", f"Run B: {run_b}", f"Alerts compared: {len(common)}",
                "same_status_pct: share of pairs with the same impact_status in both runs.",
                "link_overlap_pct: links (impacted / possible / scope review) found by both, over links found by either.",
                "only_in_a / only_in_b: pairs read in one run only (procedure shortlist differences)."]}
            ).to_excel(xl, sheet_name="How to read", index=False)
            summary.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="summary", index=False)
            per_alert.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="per alert", index=False)
            diffs.drop(columns=["_merge"]).to_excel(xl, sheet_name="different status", index=False)
        report = os.path.join(out_dir, "compare_report.xlsx")
    except Exception:
        summary.to_csv(os.path.join(out_dir, "compare_summary.csv"), index=False)
        diffs.to_csv(os.path.join(out_dir, "compare_differences.csv"), index=False)
        report = os.path.join(out_dir, "compare_summary.csv")
    return summary, per_alert, diffs, report

#### END FILE ####
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/config.py | sha256=1f7fdf5b65f9cb8eb0cd5a50185ffd21e9049c177be04876415a20a5a772c630 ####
"""Load, check and resolve config/config.yaml into a Settings object. No execution parameter is hard-coded elsewhere."""
import os
import re
import copy
from pathlib import Path

from .errors import IAError

REQUIRED = {
    "run": ["run_id", "output_dir", "log_dir", "alert_ids", "alerts_limit", "max_cost_usd", "test_gate", "reuse_search_from"],
    "country": ["code", "name", "terms", "codes", "entity_codes"],
    "sources": ["rapid2", "alert_scope", "policy_local", "policy_global", "procedure"],
    "gateway": ["mode", "base_url", "base_url_env", "staff_id", "staff_id_env", "use_case", "use_case_env",
                "quota_project", "quota_project_env", "token_lifetime_sec", "relogin_min_interval_sec",
                "http_timeout_sec", "max_connections", "mock_failure_rate"],
    "model": ["chat_model", "family", "max_tokens", "temperature", "seed", "reasoning_effort",
              "price_per_million_tokens", "embedding_model", "embedding_batch_size", "embedding_max_chars"],
    "execution": ["concurrency", "query_plan_concurrency", "embedding_concurrency", "transport_retries",
                  "answer_retries", "backoff_max_sec", "circuit_breaker_failures", "save_every", "progress_every_sec"],
    "search": ["proc_top_k", "rrf_k", "tfidf_ngram_max", "tfidf_min_df", "tfidf_max_df"],
    "rules": ["published_only", "link_threshold", "headline_min_score"],
    "logging": ["level", "log_llm_calls", "log_payloads"],
    "paths": ["prompts_dir", "schemas_dir", "exceptions_dir"],
}
PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"^<.*>$|<your |<EXECUTION_OUTPUT_DIR>")


class Settings:
    """Attribute access to the config sections: s.run["output_dir"], s.model["max_tokens"], ... plus resolved paths."""

    def __init__(self, raw, config_path):
        self.raw = raw
        self.config_path = Path(config_path).resolve()
        self.project_dir = self.config_path.parent.parent      # config/ sits in the project folder
        for section in REQUIRED:
            setattr(self, section, raw[section])
        self.country_code = str(raw["country"]["code"])

    # -- paths -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def path(self, value):
        """Resolve a path from the config: {country} filled, relative paths taken from the project folder."""
        if value is None:
            return None
        p = str(value).replace("{country}", self.country_code)
        p = os.path.expandvars(os.path.expanduser(p))
        return str(p if os.path.isabs(p) else (self.project_dir / p))

    @property
    def run_id(self):
        return str(self.run["run_id"]).replace("{country}", self.country_code)

    @property
    def output_dir(self):
        return self.path(self.run["output_dir"])

    @property
    def log_dir(self):
        return self.path(self.run["log_dir"])

    def secret(self, name):
        """Gateway setting: environment variable first, then the config value."""
        env_name = self.gateway.get(f"{name}_env")
        value = os.environ.get(env_name) if env_name else None
        return value if value else self.gateway.get(name)

    def masked(self):
        """Copy of the config safe to write to the logs (gateway secrets masked)."""
        r = copy.deepcopy(self.raw)
        for k in ("base_url", "staff_id", "use_case", "quota_project"):
            v = self.secret(k)
            r["gateway"][k] = (str(v)[:4] + "***") if v and not PLACEHOLDER.search(str(v)) else v
        return r


def _num(cfg, sec, key, kind, lo=None, hi=None):
    v = cfg[sec][key]
    try:
        v = kind(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", f"{sec}.{key} = {cfg[sec][key]!r} is not a {kind.__name__}")
    if (lo is not None and v < lo) or (hi is not None and v > hi):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", f"{sec}.{key} = {v} must be between {lo} and {hi}")
    cfg[sec][key] = v


def load_settings(config_path, overrides=None):
    """Read and validate the YAML config. overrides: dict of 'section.key' -> value (from the command line)."""
    try:
        import yaml
    except ImportError:
        raise IAError("E-ENV-001", "PyYAML (package 'pyyaml') is needed to read config.yaml")
    if not config_path or not os.path.isfile(config_path):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-001", f"config file not found: {config_path}")
    try:
        with open(config_path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            raw = yaml.safe_load(f)
    except yaml.YAMLError as e:
        raise IAError("E-CFG-002", f"{config_path}: {e}")
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-002", f"{config_path}: the file is empty or not a mapping")

    for sec, keys in REQUIRED.items():
        if not isinstance(raw.get(sec), dict):
            raise IAError("E-CFG-003", f"section '{sec}' missing")
        for k in keys:
            if k not in raw[sec]:
                raise IAError("E-CFG-003", f"'{sec}.{k}' missing")

    for dotted, value in (overrides or {}).items():
        sec, key = dotted.split(".", 1)
        raw[sec][key] = value

    # types and ranges
    _num(raw, "run", "max_cost_usd", float, 0)
    _num(raw, "model", "max_tokens", int, 256, 128000)
    _num(raw, "model", "temperature", float, 0, 2)
    _num(raw, "model", "seed", int, 0)
    _num(raw, "model", "embedding_batch_size", int, 1, 250)
    _num(raw, "model", "embedding_max_chars", int, 100)
    for k, lo, hi in (("concurrency", 1, 500), ("query_plan_concurrency", 1, 200), ("embedding_concurrency", 1, 100),
                      ("transport_retries", 1, 10), ("answer_retries", 1, 10), ("backoff_max_sec", 1, 300),
                      ("circuit_breaker_failures", 10, 100000), ("save_every", 1, 100000), ("progress_every_sec", 1, 3600)):
        _num(raw, "execution", k, int, lo, hi)
    _num(raw, "search", "proc_top_k", int, 1, 100000)
    _num(raw, "search", "rrf_k", int, 1, 10000)
    _num(raw, "search", "tfidf_ngram_max", int, 1, 3)
    _num(raw, "rules", "link_threshold", int, 0, 10)
    _num(raw, "rules", "headline_min_score", int, 0, 10)
    _num(raw, "gateway", "token_lifetime_sec", int, 30, 3600)
    _num(raw, "gateway", "relogin_min_interval_sec", int, 0, 86400)
    _num(raw, "gateway", "http_timeout_sec", float, 5, 3600)
    _num(raw, "gateway", "max_connections", int, 1, 2000)
    _num(raw, "gateway", "mock_failure_rate", float, 0, 1)
    if raw["rules"]["headline_min_score"] < raw["rules"]["link_threshold"]:
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "rules.headline_min_score must be >= rules.link_threshold")
    if raw["gateway"]["mode"] not in ("live", "mock"):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "gateway.mode must be 'live' or 'mock'")
    if str(raw["model"]["family"]).lower() not in ("auto", "gpt", "gemini"):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "model.family must be auto, gpt or gemini")
    price = raw["model"]["price_per_million_tokens"]
    if not isinstance(price, dict) or "input" not in price or "output" not in price:
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "model.price_per_million_tokens needs 'input' and 'output'")
    for k in ("terms", "codes", "entity_codes"):
        if not isinstance(raw["country"][k], list):
            raise IAError("E-CFG-004", f"country.{k} must be a list")
    if not isinstance(raw["run"]["alert_ids"], list):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "run.alert_ids must be a list (use [] for all alerts)")
    if raw["run"]["alerts_limit"] is not None:
        _num(raw, "run", "alerts_limit", int, 1)
    if raw["logging"]["level"] not in ("DEBUG", "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR"):
        raise IAError("E-CFG-004", "logging.level must be DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR")

    s = Settings(raw, config_path)
    for k, v in raw["sources"].items():
        if PLACEHOLDER.search(str(v)):
            raise IAError("E-CFG-005", f"sources.{k} still holds a placeholder: {v}")
    if raw["gateway"]["mode"] == "live":
        for k in ("base_url", "staff_id", "use_case"):
            v = s.secret(k)
            if not v or PLACEHOLDER.search(str(v)):
                raise IAError("E-CFG-005", f"gateway {k}: set environment variable {raw['gateway'][k + '_env']} "
                                           f"or gateway.{k} in the config")
    return s

#### END FILE ####
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/errors.py | sha256=ba9562c426249ca4058017e17f6ccc562a56ea54648cc6266d08f9a06356794b ####
"""Error dictionary for the alert -> policy / procedure impact-assessment pipeline.

Every problem the pipeline can meet has a code. The code appears in the console, in logs/<run>/run.log, in
logs/<run>/errors.jsonl and, for a failed (alert, document) pair, in the error_code column of the results.

Code format:  <severity>-<area>-<number>
  severity : E = error (the item or the run could not be completed), W = warning (completed, but check)
  area     : ENV environment | CFG config | PRM prompts | SCH schemas | EXC exceptions | SRC sources |
             SCP scope | GW gateway | LLM model answer | EMB embeddings | SHL shortlist | RUN run control |
             CKP checkpoints | OUT outputs

Look up a code:   python -m ia_pp explain E-GW-004
List all codes:   python -m ia_pp errors          (the same table as docs/ERROR_CODES.md)
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ErrorInfo:
    code: str
    title: str
    scope: str          # what it stops: RUN (whole run), STAGE, PAIR (one alert x document), NONE (warning)
    likely_cause: str
    action: str


# Process exit codes (what a scheduler sees)
EXIT_OK = 0                 # completed, every pair answered
EXIT_PARTIAL = 1            # completed, but some pairs have no answer (re-run the same command to retry them)
EXIT_CONFIG = 2             # config / environment / prompt / schema / source problem (nothing was spent)
EXIT_GATEWAY = 3            # gateway unusable (auth, route, circuit breaker)
EXIT_COST_CAP = 4           # cost cap reached - stopped safely, progress saved
EXIT_TEST_GATE = 5          # pre-run test gate failed - nothing big was spent
EXIT_INTERNAL = 6           # unexpected internal error - see run.log traceback
EXIT_INTERRUPTED = 130      # stopped by Ctrl+C / SIGTERM - progress saved

_E = [
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- environment
    ErrorInfo("E-ENV-001", "Required Python package missing", "RUN",
              "A package in requirements.txt is not installed in this environment.",
              "Install it (pip install -r requirements.txt) or ask the platform team. The message names the package."),
    ErrorInfo("E-ENV-002", "Python version too old", "RUN",
              "The pipeline needs Python 3.9 or newer.", "Run with a newer Python interpreter."),
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- config
    ErrorInfo("E-CFG-001", "Config file not found", "RUN",
              "Wrong --config path.", "Pass the right path, e.g. --config config/config.yaml."),
    ErrorInfo("E-CFG-002", "Config file cannot be parsed", "RUN",
              "YAML syntax error (indentation, a missing colon, a tab character).",
              "Open the file, fix the line named in the message. YAML uses spaces, never tabs."),
    ErrorInfo("E-CFG-003", "Required config setting missing", "RUN",

    ErrorInfo("E-PRM-002", "Unresolved placeholder in a prompt", "RUN",
              "A prompt contains {{...}} that the code does not fill (only {{COUNTRY_NAME}} is supported).",
              "Remove or correct the placeholder in the prompt file."),

    ErrorInfo("E-EXC-001", "Exceptions file malformed", "RUN",

              "Keep the header 'doc_id,title,reason'. Lines starting with # are comments."),

              "An id in exceptions/ does not exist in the loaded GPPS files (typo, or retired document).",
              "Check the id. The run continues; the entry has no effect."),
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- sources
    ErrorInfo("E-SRC-001", "Source file not found", "RUN",
              "Wrong path or glob in config 'sources', or the file has not been delivered yet.",
              "Fix the path. A glob such as .../rsm_linkage_pairs_*.parquet takes the newest match."),
    ErrorInfo("E-SRC-002", "Source file unreadable", "RUN",
              "Corrupt file, unsupported format, or a parquet written by an incompatible library version.",
              "Re-export the file as parquet, csv or xlsx."),
    ErrorInfo("E-SRC-003", "Required column missing in a source file", "RUN",
              "The extract layout changed (e.g. RECORD_ID, TITLE, json_data, policy_core_id).",
              "Ask the data owner for the expected layout, or map the column in the source."),
    ErrorInfo("E-SRC-004", "No alerts to assess", "RUN",
              "The alert-scope file has no RECORD_IDs found in Rapid2, or none of --alert-ids is in scope.",
              "Check both files / the ids you passed."),
    ErrorInfo("E-SRC-005", "No GPPS documents after parsing", "RUN",
              "Wrong GPPS files, json_data unparseable, or no published version.",
              "Check the files; see W-SRC-001 counts in the log."),
    ErrorInfo("W-SRC-001", "Some GPPS rows could not be parsed", "NONE",
              "json_data is empty or not valid JSON for some rows.", "Those documents are skipped; report the count to the GPPS team if large."),
    ErrorInfo("W-SRC-002", "Requested alert ids not in scope", "NONE",
              "Some ids passed with --alert-ids / run.alert_ids are not in the alert-scope file.", "They are ignored. Check the ids."),
    ErrorInfo("W-SRC-003", "Document without visible text", "NONE",
              "All segments are hidden or empty.", "The document cannot be assessed and is left out."),
    ErrorInfo("W-SCP-001", "Document scope decided by its source file", "NONE",
              "GPPS has no level / country field for the document.", "Scope = LOCAL if it came from the local file, else GLOBAL. Check if unexpected."),
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- gateway
    ErrorInfo("E-GW-001", "Gateway client could not be created", "RUN",

              "No token method on GroupAIClient, or the login service is down.",
              "Check the staff id / use case; retry later."),

              "Login expired (about 1 h) or the use case lacks access. The code re-logs in automatically.",
              "If it persists: check staff id / use case access, then re-run (finished pairs are kept)."),
    ErrorInfo("E-GW-004", "Rate limited (429)", "PAIR",
              "Too many parallel calls for the shared gateway.", "Retried automatically. If frequent, lower execution.concurrency."),
    ErrorInfo("E-GW-005", "Gateway server error (5xx)", "PAIR",
              "Temporary gateway / model problem.", "Retried automatically; re-run later for the remaining pairs."),
    ErrorInfo("E-GW-006", "Gateway timeout", "PAIR",

    ErrorInfo("W-LLM-001", "Optional answer field invalid", "NONE",
              "e.g. link_score 'eight', impact_type misspelt.", "Value set to null (or coerced); the answer is kept."),
    ErrorInfo("W-LLM-002", "Cited section ids not in the document", "NONE",

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- embeddings / shortlist
    ErrorInfo("E-EMB-001", "Embedding batch failed after retries", "STAGE",
              "Gateway problem on the embedding model.", "Re-run: finished embeddings are cached and not paid again."),
    ErrorInfo("E-EMB-002", "Embedding size mismatch", "STAGE",
              "The cache was built with another embedding model.", "Delete the emb_*.npz files in the output folder, or restore the model."),
    ErrorInfo("W-EMB-001", "Embedding cache unreadable - rebuilt", "NONE",

    ErrorInfo("E-SHL-001", "Query plans missing after retries", "STAGE",

              "New alerts, new query plans or a different top-K.", "Alerts already in the saved shortlist keep it; missing alerts get a fresh shortlist."),
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- run control
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-001", "Cost cap reached", "RUN",
              "Estimated or measured spend reached run.max_cost_usd.",
              "Progress is saved. Raise the cap if the spend is expected, then re-run the same command."),
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-002", "Interrupted", "RUN",
              "Ctrl+C, Kernel > Interrupt or SIGTERM from the scheduler.", "Progress is saved; re-run the same command to continue."),
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-003", "Test gate failed", "RUN",
              "The 10-pair test before the full run had errors, unverifiable quotes or a cost above the cap.",
              "Read the test table in run.log; fix the cause before the full run."),
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-004", "Unexpected error on one pair", "PAIR",
              "A bug or an unusual document. The traceback is in run.log.", "The pair is marked ERROR and retried on the next run. Report the traceback."),
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-005", "Unexpected error in a stage", "RUN",
              "A bug or an unusual input. The traceback is in run.log.", "Report run.log and errors.jsonl to RCAI&A."),
    ErrorInfo("E-RUN-006", "Document text shorter than its source", "RUN",
              "The no-truncation check failed: a document would not be sent in full.", "Report to RCAI&A; nothing was spent."),
    ErrorInfo("W-RUN-001", "Pairs without an answer at the end of a stage", "NONE",
              "Their calls failed every retry (see their error_code).", "Re-run the same command: only those pairs are retried."),
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- checkpoints / outputs
    ErrorInfo("W-CKP-001", "Damaged checkpoint lines skipped", "NONE",
              "The process was killed while writing the last line.", "Those pairs are simply read again."),
    ErrorInfo("E-CKP-001", "Checkpoint unreadable", "STAGE",
              "The checkpoint file is damaged beyond line level.", "Rename it (to keep a copy) and re-run; the stage restarts."),
    ErrorInfo("E-OUT-001", "Cannot write output", "RUN",
              "Folder not writable, disk full, or a file open in another program.", "Free space / fix permissions; re-run."),
    ErrorInfo("W-OUT-001", "Excel summary not written", "NONE",
              "openpyxl missing or the file is open elsewhere.", "Parquet, CSV and JSONL outputs are still written."),
    ErrorInfo("E-OUT-002", "No pair results to report", "RUN",
              "The results stage ran before the policy / procedure stages.", "Run --stage policies and procedures first (or --stage all)."),
]

ERRORS = {e.code: e for e in _E}


class IAError(Exception):
    """An expected, classified failure. `code` is a key of ERRORS; `detail` says what exactly happened."""

    def __init__(self, code, detail="", **context):
        self.code = code if code in ERRORS else "E-RUN-005"
        self.detail = str(detail)
        self.context = context
        info = ERRORS[self.code]
        super().__init__(f"[{self.code}] {info.title}: {self.detail}")


EXIT_FOR_CODE = {
    "ENV": EXIT_CONFIG, "CFG": EXIT_CONFIG, "PRM": EXIT_CONFIG, "SCH": EXIT_CONFIG, "EXC": EXIT_CONFIG,
    "SRC": EXIT_CONFIG, "GW": EXIT_GATEWAY, "OUT": EXIT_INTERNAL, "CKP": EXIT_INTERNAL, "EMB": EXIT_GATEWAY,
    "SHL": EXIT_GATEWAY,
}


def exit_code_for(code):
    if code == "E-RUN-001":
        return EXIT_COST_CAP
    if code == "E-RUN-002":
        return EXIT_INTERRUPTED
    if code == "E-RUN-003":
        return EXIT_TEST_GATE
    if code in ("E-RUN-006",):
        return EXIT_CONFIG
    area = code.split("-")[1] if code.count("-") >= 2 else ""
    return EXIT_FOR_CODE.get(area, EXIT_INTERNAL)


def explain(code):
    e = ERRORS.get(code.strip().upper())
    if not e:
        return f"Unknown code {code!r}. List all codes with: python -m ia_pp errors"
    return (f"{e.code}  {e.title}\n  stops      : {e.scope}\n  likely cause: {e.likely_cause}\n"
            f"  what to do : {e.action}")


def as_markdown():
    lines = ["# Error codes", "", "Generated from `ia_pp/errors.py` (`python -m ia_pp errors`).", "",
             "| Code | Title | Stops | Likely cause | What to do |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for e in _E:
        lines.append(f"| {e.code} | {e.title} | {e.scope} | {e.likely_cause} | {e.action} |")
    lines += ["", "## Exit codes", "", "| Exit code | Meaning |", "|---|---|",
              f"| {EXIT_OK} | Completed, every pair answered |",
              f"| {EXIT_PARTIAL} | Completed, some pairs without answer: re-run the same command to retry only those |",
              f"| {EXIT_CONFIG} | Config / environment / prompt / schema / source problem (nothing spent) |",
              f"| {EXIT_GATEWAY} | Gateway unusable (authentication, route, circuit breaker) |",
              f"| {EXIT_COST_CAP} | Cost cap reached, progress saved |",
              f"| {EXIT_TEST_GATE} | Pre-run test gate failed |",
              f"| {EXIT_INTERNAL} | Unexpected internal error (see run.log) |",
              f"| {EXIT_INTERRUPTED} | Interrupted, progress saved |"]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

#### END FILE ####
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/gateway.py | sha256=3fcd1ac43945353a75e88038738a19f237930a17f654819beeda9bd4c18cc792 ####
"""Bank AI gateway (live) and an offline simulator (mock) behind one interface.

    result = await gw.chat(system_prompt, payload_dict, ref={...})  -> ChatResult(ok, data, code, detail, ...)
    vectors = await gw.embed(list_of_texts)                          -> numpy array (raises IAError on failure)

Every call is logged to llm_calls.jsonl (ids, timing, tokens, status, error code - never the text unless
logging.log_payloads). Errors are classified into E-GW-* / E-LLM-* codes (see errors.py).
"""
import os
import ssl
import json
import time
import uuid
import random
import asyncio
import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass

import numpy as np

from .errors import IAError

RETRYABLE = {"E-GW-003", "E-GW-004", "E-GW-005", "E-GW-006", "E-GW-007", "E-GW-012",
             "E-LLM-001", "E-LLM-002", "E-LLM-004"}
GATEWAY_FATAL = {"E-GW-008"}          # wrong model / url: retrying cannot help


@dataclass
class ChatResult:
    ok: bool
    data: dict = None
    code: str = None
    detail: str = ""
    tokens_in: int = 0
    tokens_out: int = 0
    attempts: int = 0
    finish_reason: str = None


class Usage:
    """Token and cost counters, per stage and total."""

    def __init__(self, price_in_per_m, price_out_per_m):
        self.p_in, self.p_out = float(price_in_per_m) / 1e6, float(price_out_per_m) / 1e6
        self.stages = {}

    def add(self, stage, tin, tout, ok=True):
        st = self.stages.setdefault(stage, {"calls": 0, "failed_calls": 0, "in": 0, "out": 0})
        st["calls" if ok else "failed_calls"] += 1
        st["in"] += int(tin or 0)
        st["out"] += int(tout or 0)

    def cost(self, stage=None):
        sts = [self.stages.get(stage, {})] if stage else list(self.stages.values())
        return float(sum(x.get("in", 0) * self.p_in + x.get("out", 0) * self.p_out for x in sts))

    def report(self):
        return {k: {**v, "cost_usd": round(self.cost(k), 4)} for k, v in self.stages.items()} | \
            {"_total_cost_usd": round(self.cost(), 4)}


def classify(exc):
    """Exception from the openai / httpx client -> error code."""
    status = getattr(exc, "status_code", None) or getattr(getattr(exc, "response", None), "status_code", None)
    name, msg = type(exc).__name__.lower(), str(exc).lower()
    if status in (401, 403) or "unauthor" in msg or "forbidden" in msg:
        return "E-GW-003"
    if status == 404 or "no route" in msg:
        return "E-GW-008"
    if status == 429 or "rate limit" in msg:
        return "E-GW-004"
    if status in (400, 413, 422):
        return "E-GW-009"
    if status is not None and 500 <= int(status) < 600:
        return "E-GW-005"
    if "timeout" in name or "timed out" in msg:
        return "E-GW-006"
    if "connect" in name or "ssl" in msg or "certificate" in msg or "connection" in msg:
        return "E-GW-007"
    return "E-GW-012"


def parse_json_answer(text):
    """Model text -> dict. Tolerates ```json fences and text around the JSON object."""
    t = (text or "").replace("```json", "").replace("```", "").strip()
    if not t:
        raise ValueError("empty")
    a, b = t.find("{"), t.rfind("}")
    if a < 0 or b <= a:
        raise ValueError("no JSON object in the answer")
    d = json.loads(t[a:b + 1])
    if isinstance(d, dict) and isinstance(d.get("items"), list) and d["items"] and isinstance(d["items"][0], dict):
        d = d["items"][0]                                    # some models wrap the object in {"items": [...]}
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        raise ValueError("JSON is not an object")
    return d


class _Base:
    def __init__(self, s, log, usage):
        self.s, self.log, self.usage = s, log, usage
        self.stage = "setup"
        ex = s.execution
        self.transport_retries, self.backoff_max = ex["transport_retries"], ex["backoff_max_sec"]

    async def _sleep(self, attempt, code):
        base = min(2 ** attempt, self.backoff_max)
        if code == "E-GW-004":                               # rate limited: back off harder
            base = min(base * 3, self.backoff_max * 3)
        await asyncio.sleep(base * (0.5 + random.random()))

    def _log_call(self, ref, attempt, status, code, t0, tin=0, tout=0, finish=None):
        self.log.llm_call(alert=ref.get("alert"), doc=ref.get("doc"), attempt=attempt, status=status, code=code,
                          ms=int((time.time() - t0) * 1000), tokens_in=tin, tokens_out=tout, finish=finish)


class LiveGateway(_Base):
    """OpenAI-compatible bank gateway with a Bearer token from py_group_ai_tools."""

    def __init__(self, s, log, usage, client=None, token_fn=None):
        super().__init__(s, log, usage)
        g, m = s.gateway, s.model
        self.model = m["chat_model"]
        fam = str(m["family"]).lower()
        self.family = ("gemini" if "gemini" in self.model.lower() else "gpt") if fam == "auto" else fam
        self.use_case = s.secret("use_case")
        self.token_lifetime, self.relogin_gap = g["token_lifetime_sec"], g["relogin_min_interval_sec"]
        self._token, self._token_exp, self._lock = None, 0.0, None
        self._last_relogin = 0.0
        self._group_client = None
        if client is not None:                               # injected (tests)
            self.client, self._token_fn = client, token_fn
            return
        try:
            import httpx
            import openai
        except ImportError as e:
            raise IAError("E-ENV-001", f"{e.name} (needed for the live gateway)")
        qp = s.secret("quota_project")
        if qp and not str(qp).startswith("<"):
            os.environ.setdefault("GOOGLE_CLOUD_QUOTA_PROJECT", str(qp))
        try:
            try:
                import truststore
                verify = truststore.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT)
            except ImportError:
                verify = True
            http = httpx.AsyncClient(http2=self._has_h2(), verify=verify, timeout=httpx.Timeout(g["http_timeout_sec"]),
                                     limits=httpx.Limits(max_connections=g["max_connections"],
                                                         max_keepalive_connections=min(200, g["max_connections"])))
            self.client = openai.AsyncOpenAI(
                api_key="N/A", http_client=http, base_url=s.secret("base_url"),
                default_headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "x-correlation-id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                                 "x-usersession-id": str(uuid.uuid4())})
        except Exception as e:
            raise IAError("E-GW-001", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        self._token_fn = self._login()

    @staticmethod
    def _has_h2():
        try:
            import h2  # noqa: F401
            return True
        except ImportError:
            return False

    def _login(self):
        try:
            from py_group_ai_tools import GroupAIClient
        except ImportError:
            raise IAError("E-ENV-001", "py_group_ai_tools (bank gateway client)")
        try:
            gc = GroupAIClient.init(staff_id=self.s.secret("staff_id"))
        except Exception as e:
            raise IAError("E-GW-001", f"GroupAIClient.init failed: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        names = ["get_dsp_token", "get_dap_token", "get_token", "get_access_token", "get_bearer_token"]
        names += sorted(n for n in dir(gc) if "token" in n.lower() and not n.startswith("_"))
        method = next((n for n in names if callable(getattr(gc, n, None))), None)
        if not method:
            raise IAError("E-GW-002", "no token method found on GroupAIClient")
        self._group_client = gc
        self.log.debug(f"gateway token method: {method}")
        return getattr(gc, method)

    async def _get_token(self):
        if self._lock is None:
            self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        now = time.time()
        if self._token and now < self._token_exp - 5:
            return self._token
        async with self._lock:
            now = time.time()
            if self._token and now < self._token_exp - 5:
                return self._token
            try:
                self._token = await asyncio.to_thread(self._token_fn)
            except Exception as e:
                raise IAError("E-GW-002", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            self._token_exp = now + self.token_lifetime
            return self._token

    async def _on_auth_error(self):
        self._token, self._token_exp = None, 0.0
        if self._group_client is None or time.time() - self._last_relogin < self.relogin_gap:
            return
        self._last_relogin = time.time()
        try:
            self._token_fn = await asyncio.to_thread(self._login)
            self.log.info("  gateway: logged in again after an authentication error")
        except Exception as e:
            self.log.event("E-GW-002", f"re-login failed: {e}")

    def _kwargs(self, system, payload):
        m = self.s.model
        kw = {"model": self.model, "user": self.use_case,
              "messages": [{"role": "system", "content": system},
                           {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False)}]}
        if self.family == "gemini":
            kw.update(temperature=m["temperature"], seed=m["seed"], reasoning_effort=m["reasoning_effort"],
                      max_tokens=m["max_tokens"])
        else:
            kw.update(max_completion_tokens=m["max_tokens"])
        return kw

    async def chat(self, system, payload, ref=None):
        ref = ref or {}
        kw = self._kwargs(system, payload)
        code, detail, tin, tout, finish = None, "", 0, 0, None
        for attempt in range(1, self.transport_retries + 1):
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                token = await self._get_token()
                r = await self.client.chat.completions.create(extra_headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}, **kw)
            except IAError as e:
                code, detail = e.code, e.detail
                self._log_call(ref, attempt, "error", code, t0)
                await self._sleep(attempt, code)
                continue
            except Exception as e:
                code, detail = classify(e), f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:300]}"
                self._log_call(ref, attempt, "error", code, t0)
                self.usage.add(self.stage, 0, 0, ok=False)
                if code == "E-GW-003":
                    await self._on_auth_error()
                if code not in RETRYABLE:
                    break
                await self._sleep(attempt, code)
                continue
            u = getattr(r, "usage", None)
            tin, tout = getattr(u, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0, getattr(u, "completion_tokens", 0) or 0
            self.usage.add(self.stage, tin, tout, ok=True)
            try:
                choice = r.choices[0]
                finish = getattr(choice, "finish_reason", None)
                text = choice.message.content or ""
            except Exception:
                text = ""
            self.log.payload(alert=ref.get("alert"), doc=ref.get("doc"), attempt=attempt, payload=payload, answer=text)
            if not text.strip():
                code, detail = ("E-LLM-004" if finish == "length" else "E-LLM-001"), f"finish_reason={finish}"
                self._log_call(ref, attempt, "error", code, t0, tin, tout, finish)
                await self._sleep(attempt, code)
                continue
            try:
                data = parse_json_answer(text)
            except Exception as e:
                code = "E-LLM-004" if finish == "length" else "E-LLM-002"
                detail = f"{e}; finish_reason={finish}; starts: {text[:120]!r}"
                self._log_call(ref, attempt, "error", code, t0, tin, tout, finish)
                await self._sleep(attempt, code)
                continue
            self._log_call(ref, attempt, "ok", None, t0, tin, tout, finish)
            return ChatResult(True, data, None, "", tin, tout, attempt, finish)
        return ChatResult(False, None, code or "E-GW-012", detail, tin, tout, self.transport_retries, finish)

    async def embed(self, texts):
        last = None
        for attempt in range(1, 7):
            t0 = time.time()
            try:
                token = await self._get_token()
                r = await self.client.embeddings.create(model=self.s.model["embedding_model"], input=texts,
                                                        user=self.use_case,
                                                        extra_headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"})
                self.log.llm_call(alert=None, doc=f"embed x{len(texts)}", attempt=attempt, status="ok", code=None,
                                  ms=int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
                return np.asarray([d.embedding for d in r.data], dtype=np.float32)
            except Exception as e:
                code = e.code if isinstance(e, IAError) else classify(e)
                last = f"{code} {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
                self.log.llm_call(alert=None, doc=f"embed x{len(texts)}", attempt=attempt, status="error", code=code,
                                  ms=int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
                if code == "E-GW-003":
                    await self._on_auth_error()
                if code in GATEWAY_FATAL:
                    break
                await self._sleep(attempt, code)
        raise IAError("E-EMB-001", last or "unknown")


class MockGateway(_Base):
    """Offline simulator: no network, no cost. Deterministic answers built from the real texts, so every downstream
    rule (quote check, sections, bands, framework rule, outputs) runs exactly as in production.
    gateway.mock_failure_rate injects failures to exercise retries, ERROR rows and the re-run path."""

    def __init__(self, s, log, usage):
        super().__init__(s, log, usage)
        self.fail_rate = float(s.gateway["mock_failure_rate"])
        self.latency = float(s.gateway.get("mock_latency_sec", 0) or 0)
        self.rng = random.Random(int(s.model["seed"]))

    @staticmethod
    def _h(*parts):
        return int(hashlib.md5("|".join(map(str, parts)).encode()).hexdigest(), 16)

    async def chat(self, system, payload, ref=None):
        ref = ref or {}
        await asyncio.sleep(self.latency * (0.5 + self.rng.random()) if self.latency else 0)
        for attempt in range(1, self.transport_retries + 1):
            t0 = time.time()
            if self.rng.random() < self.fail_rate:
                code = self.rng.choice(["E-GW-004", "E-GW-005", "E-GW-006", "E-LLM-002"])
                self._log_call(ref, attempt, "error", code, t0)
                self.usage.add(self.stage, 0, 0, ok=False)
                continue
            data = self._answer(system, payload)
            tin = (len(system) + len(json.dumps(payload))) // 4
            self.usage.add(self.stage, tin, 400, ok=True)
            self._log_call(ref, attempt, "ok", None, t0, tin, 400, "stop")
            return ChatResult(True, data, None, "", tin, 400, attempt, "stop")
        return ChatResult(False, None, "E-GW-005", "mock: injected failures on every attempt", 0, 0,
                          self.transport_retries)

    def _answer(self, system, p):
        if "SEARCH QUERIES" in system:
            words = p.get("alert_text", "").split()
            return {"alert_id": p.get("alert_id"), "core_mandate": " ".join(words[:12]),
                    "requirements": [" ".join(words[i:i + 8]) for i in range(0, min(len(words), 24), 8)] or ["n/a"],
                    "affected_activities": words[3:6], "policy_language": [" ".join(words[:10])],
                    "procedure_language": [" ".join(words[2:12])], "keywords": words[:8]}
        kind = "policy" if "policy_id" in p else "procedure"
        doc = p.get(f"{kind}_id")
        h = self._h(p.get("alert_id"), doc)
        linked = h % 4 == 0
        score = 5 + h % 6 if linked else h % 5
        sections = [b.split("|")[0].strip("[ ") for b in p.get("document_text", "").split("\n") if b.startswith("[S")]
        first_line = next((ln for ln in p.get("document_text", "").split("\n") if ln and not ln.startswith("[S")), "")
        ans = {f"{kind}_id": doc,
               "reasoning": f"Mock reasoning for {doc}.",
               "decision": "LINKED" if linked else "NOT_LINKED", "link_score": score,
               "confidence_level": 3 + h % 3,
               "evidence_from_alert": p.get("alert_text", "")[:90] if linked else None,
               f"evidence_from_{kind}": first_line[:90] if linked else None,
               "linked_sections": sections[:1] if linked else [],
               "impact_type": ("CHANGE_REQUIRED" if h % 3 == 0 else "REVIEW_REQUIRED") if linked else "NONE",
               "change_needed": "Mock: review the cited section." if linked else None}
        if p.get("document_role") == "FRAMEWORK":
            ans["framework_change"] = "YES" if linked and h % 2 == 0 else "NO"
        return ans

    async def embed(self, texts):
        await asyncio.sleep(0)
        out = []
        for t in texts:
            v = np.random.default_rng(self._h(t) % (2 ** 32)).random(32).astype(np.float32)
            out.append(v)
        self.log.llm_call(alert=None, doc=f"embed x{len(texts)}", attempt=1, status="ok", code=None, ms=0)
        return np.vstack(out)


def make_gateway(s, log, usage):
    return MockGateway(s, log, usage) if s.gateway["mode"] == "mock" else LiveGateway(s, log, usage)

#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/gpps.py | sha256=462b058ff508669f7abd5b0f20ac3853078c734b91c5ebe849b74f59fbb75715 ####
"""GPPS JSON -> documents -> sections -> sub-sections (GPPS UI numbering). Same parsing as the validated notebook."""
import re
import json
import html
import hashlib

import pandas as pd

from .errors import IAError
from .io_utils import read_table

NA = {"", "n/a", "na", "-", "--", "none", "nan", "null"}


def N(x):
    """Normalised id: upper case, '123.0' -> '123'."""
    s = str(x).strip().upper()
    return s[:-2] if re.fullmatch(r"\d+\.0", s) else s


def clean(x):
    return "" if x is None or str(x).strip().lower() in NA else str(x).strip()


def as_str(x):
    if x is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(x, list):
        return " | ".join(str(i).strip() for i in x if i is not None and str(i).strip())
    return str(x).strip()


def as_dict(x):
    if isinstance(x, list):
        x = next((i for i in x if isinstance(i, dict)), {})
    return x if isinstance(x, dict) else {}


def as_list(x):
    return [i for i in x if isinstance(i, dict)] if isinstance(x, list) else []


def first(d, keys):
    for k in keys:
        v = d.get(k)
        if v not in (None, "", []):
            return v
    return None


def strip_html(s):
    if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
        return ""
    s = re.sub(r"(?is)<!doctype.*?>|<head.*?>.*?</head>", " ", s)
    s = re.sub(r"(?s)<[^>]+>", " ", s)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", html.unescape(s)).strip()


def load_json(raw):
    if isinstance(raw, dict):
        return raw
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def pick(df, *cands):
    return next((c for c in cands if c in df.columns), None)


HEADING = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Z]?\.?\d+(?:\.\d+){1,3})\.?\s+(.{3,150}?)\s*$")   # "2.2. Model Inputs" / "B.2.7.4 Use of"
MARK = "␞SUBHEAD␞"


def split_subsections(raw_html, section_no, strict_prefix):
    """Numbered bold / underlined headings inside a segment's HTML become sub-sections."""
    if not isinstance(raw_html, str) or not raw_html.strip():
        return []
    found = []

    def mark(m):
        inner = strip_html(m.group(0))
        h = HEADING.match(inner)
        top = re.sub(r"^[A-Z]\.?", "", h.group(1)).split(".")[0] if h else ""
        if h and (not strict_prefix or not section_no or top == str(section_no).split(".")[0]):
            found.append((h.group(1), h.group(2).strip(" :")))
            return f" {MARK}{len(found) - 1}{MARK} "
        return m.group(0)

    marked = re.sub(r"(?is)<(strong|b|u)\b[^>]*>.*?</\1>|<span[^>]*underline[^>]*>.*?</span>", mark, raw_html)
    parts = re.split(rf"{MARK}(\d+){MARK}", strip_html(marked))
    subs, seen = [], set()
    if parts[0].strip():
        subs.append({"sub_no": f"{section_no}.0" if section_no else "", "sub_title": "(section introduction)",
                     "text": parts[0].strip()})
    for i in range(1, len(parts), 2):
        num, title = found[int(parts[i])]
        body = parts[i + 1].strip() if i + 1 < len(parts) else ""
        if (num, body[:200]) in seen:
            continue                                                  # GPPS sometimes repeats a block
        seen.add((num, body[:200]))
        subs.append({"sub_no": num, "sub_title": title, "text": body})
    return subs


KEYS = {
    "policy": dict(app="policyApplication", core=["plcyCoreId"], title=["policyTitle"],
                   status=("versn", ["versStatCde"]), top=[("policyText", "Policy Statement"), ("policyPurpose", "Purpose")],
                   seg_text=["sgmntText"], seg_title=["sgmntTitlText"], seg_disp=["sgmntDispInd"],
                   seg_no=["dispSortOrdrNum", "sortOrdrNum"], seg_reason=["sgmntReasonText"], strict=True),
    "procedure": dict(app="procedureApplication", core=["procCoreId"], title=["procedureTitle"],
                      status=("versn", ["procVersnStatCde", "versStatCde"]), top=[("procedureText", "Procedure Statement")],
                      seg_text=["procSgmntText", "sgmntText"], seg_title=["procSgmntTitlText", "sgmntTitlText"],
                      seg_disp=["procSgmntDispInd", "sgmntDispInd"],
                      seg_no=["procDispSortOrdrNum", "procSortOrdrNum", "dispSortOrdrNum", "sortOrdrNum"],
                      seg_reason=["procSgmntReasonText", "sgmntReasonText"], strict=False),
}
ID_COLUMNS = ("policy_core_id", "procedure_core_id", "policy_id", "procedure_id")


def parse_doc(raw, kind):
    K = KEYS[kind]
    d = load_json(raw)
    if not d:
        return None
    app = as_dict(d.get(K["app"]))
    secs = []
    for key, label in K["top"]:
        o = as_dict(d.get(key))
        secs.append(dict(section_no="", title=strip_html(as_str(o.get("sgmntTitlText") or label)),
                         html=o.get("sgmntText") or "", displayed="Y", reason="", kind="top"))
    for s in as_list(app.get("segment")):
        secs.append(dict(section_no=clean(as_str(first(s, K["seg_no"]))),
                         title=strip_html(as_str(first(s, K["seg_title"]) or "Section")),
                         html=first(s, K["seg_text"]) or "",
                         displayed=(clean(as_str(first(s, K["seg_disp"]))).upper() or "Y"),
                         reason=strip_html(as_str(first(s, K["seg_reason"]))), kind="segment"))
    out, seen = [], set()
    for s in secs:
        text = strip_html(s["html"])
        if not text:
            continue
        h = hashlib.md5(text.encode()).hexdigest()
        if h in seen:
            continue                                                  # duplicate segment text
        seen.add(h)
        subs = split_subsections(s["html"], s["section_no"], K["strict"]) if s["kind"] == "segment" else []
        out.append({**{k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != "html"}, "text": text,
                    "subsections": subs or [{"sub_no": "", "sub_title": "", "text": text}]})
    ver = as_dict(d.get(K["status"][0]))
    return dict(core_id=N(first(d, K["core"]) or ""), title=clean(as_str(first(d, K["title"]))),
                status=clean(as_str(first(ver, K["status"][1]))), sections=out)


def load_docs(path, kind, scope, published_only, log):
    df = read_table(path)
    if "json_data" not in df.columns:
        raise IAError("E-SRC-003", f"{path}: column 'json_data' missing (columns: {list(df.columns)[:15]})")
    idc = pick(df, *ID_COLUMNS)
    recs, bad = [], 0
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        try:
            p = parse_doc(r["json_data"], kind)
        except Exception as e:                                        # one odd document never stops the run
            log.debug(f"parse error in {path}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
            p = None
        if p is None:
            bad += 1
            continue
        p.update(doc_id=N(r[idc]) if idc else p["core_id"], version=r.get("version_num"), scope=scope, kind=kind)
        recs.append(p)
    if bad:
        log.event("W-SRC-001", f"{bad:,} of {len(df):,} rows in {path} not parseable - skipped")
    out = pd.DataFrame(recs)
    n_all = len(out)
    if not len(out):
        return out
    if published_only:
        out = out[out.status.astype(str).str.upper().str.startswith("PUBL")]
    out = out.assign(_v=pd.to_numeric(out.version, errors="coerce").fillna(-1))
    out = out.sort_values("_v", ascending=False).drop_duplicates("doc_id").drop(columns="_v").reset_index(drop=True)
    log.info(f"  {kind:9s} {scope:6s}: {n_all:,} rows -> {len(out):,} documents (published, latest version)")
    return out


def build_units(docs):
    """Assessment unit = a visible numbered SUB-SECTION; a visible section without numbered sub-sections is one
    unit. Hidden segments (shown 'N' in the GPPS UI) are flagged hidden=True and excluded later."""
    rows = []
    for d in docs.itertuples():
        prefix = "POL" if d.kind == "policy" else "PROC"
        for s in d.sections:
            for sub in s["subsections"]:
                rows.append(dict(
                    unit_id=f"{prefix}-{d.doc_id}|{s['section_no'] or s['title'][:20]}|{sub['sub_no'] or '-'}",
                    doc_type=d.kind, doc_id=f"{prefix}-{d.doc_id}", doc_title=d.title, scope=d.scope,
                    section_no=s["section_no"], section_title=s["title"], subsection_no=sub["sub_no"],
                    subsection_title=sub["sub_title"], hidden=s["displayed"] == "N", hidden_reason=s["reason"],
                    level="sub-section" if sub["sub_no"] else "section", text=sub["text"], chars=len(sub["text"])))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/io_utils.py | sha256=faf848f4a32ab417aafe6dfc38d9ca0290d9c63534e72c298a9211db62d35c18 ####
"""File helpers: tolerant readers, atomic writers, append-only checkpoints."""
import os
import glob
import json

import pandas as pd

from .errors import IAError


def resolve_source(pattern):
    """A path, or a glob (newest match). Returns None if nothing exists."""
    p = str(pattern)
    if any(ch in p for ch in "*?["):
        hits = sorted(glob.glob(p, recursive=True), key=os.path.getmtime)
        return hits[-1] if hits else None
    return p if os.path.exists(p) else None


def read_table(path):
    """parquet / csv / xlsx -> DataFrame, with a fallback for parquet files that carry odd metadata."""
    p = str(path)
    try:
        if p.lower().endswith((".xlsx", ".xls")):
            return pd.read_excel(p)
        if p.lower().endswith(".csv"):
            return pd.read_csv(p)
        try:
            return pd.read_parquet(p)
        except Exception:
            import pyarrow.parquet as pq
            return pq.read_table(p).replace_schema_metadata(None).to_pandas(date_as_object=True)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        raise IAError("E-SRC-001", p)
    except Exception as e:
        raise IAError("E-SRC-002", f"{p}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")


def ensure_dir(path):
    try:
        os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
        probe = os.path.join(path, ".write_test")
        with open(probe, "w") as f:
            f.write("ok")
        os.remove(probe)
    except OSError as e:
        raise IAError("E-OUT-001", f"folder not writable: {path} ({e})")


def _stringify_objects(df):
    out = df.copy()
    for c in out.columns:
        if out[c].dtype == object:
            out[c] = out[c].map(lambda v: None if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and v != v) else str(v))
    return out


def write_parquet(df, path):
    """Atomic: written to a temporary file, then renamed (a crash never leaves half a file)."""
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    try:
        _stringify_objects(df).to_parquet(tmp, index=False)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except Exception as e:
        try:
            if os.path.exists(tmp):
                os.remove(tmp)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise IAError("E-OUT-001", f"{path}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")


def write_text(text, path):
    tmp = path + ".tmp"
    try:
        with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
    except Exception as e:
        raise IAError("E-OUT-001", f"{path}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")


def write_json(obj, path):
    write_text(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str), path)


class JsonlCheckpoint:
    """Append-only checkpoint, one JSON line per finished (alert, document) pair.

    Appending never rewrites earlier work, so a crash loses at most the lines not yet flushed. On load the last
    line per key wins, ERROR rows are dropped (so they are retried) and damaged lines are skipped (W-CKP-001)."""

    def __init__(self, path, key=("alert", "doc"), log=None):
        self.path, self.key, self.log = path, key, log
        self._buf = []

    def load(self):
        if not os.path.exists(self.path):
            return []
        rows, bad = {}, 0
        try:
            with open(self.path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for line in f:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if not line:
                        continue
                    try:
                        r = json.loads(line)
                        rows[tuple(r[k] for k in self.key)] = r
                    except Exception:
                        bad += 1
        except OSError as e:
            raise IAError("E-CKP-001", f"{self.path}: {e}")
        if bad and self.log:
            self.log.event("W-CKP-001", f"{bad} damaged line(s) in {os.path.basename(self.path)} skipped")
        return [r for r in rows.values() if r.get("model_decision") != "ERROR"]

    def add(self, row):
        self._buf.append(row)

    def flush(self):
        if not self._buf:
            return
        try:
            with open(self.path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                for r in self._buf:
                    f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False, default=str) + "\n")
                f.flush()
                os.fsync(f.fileno())
            self._buf = []
        except OSError as e:
            raise IAError("E-OUT-001", f"checkpoint {self.path}: {e}")

#### END FILE ####
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/logs.py | sha256=42fc6c3cdcb88166f8cfdf48da28457dd91016cd4e73c4cca7b435bd512b3b06 ####
"""Run logging. One folder per run: <log_dir>/<run_id>/<YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS>/

  run.log            everything (console lines + DEBUG detail + tracebacks)
  errors.jsonl       one JSON line per warning / error: time, code, stage, alert, doc, attempt, detail
  llm_calls.jsonl    one JSON line per gateway call: time, stage, alert, doc, attempt, status, code, ms, tokens
  payloads.jsonl     (only if logging.log_payloads) full model input and answer text - sensitive, debug only
  config_used.yaml   the effective config, gateway secrets masked
  run_summary.json   written at the end: stages, counts, cost, error-code counts, exit code
"""
import os
import sys
import json
import time
import logging
import datetime
from collections import Counter

from .errors import ERRORS


class RunLog:
    def __init__(self, log_dir, run_id, level="INFO", log_llm_calls=True, log_payloads=False):
        stamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        self.dir = os.path.join(log_dir, run_id, stamp)
        try:
            os.makedirs(self.dir, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            # last resort: a writable folder, so that a bad log path never stops the diagnosis
            self.dir = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "ia_pp_logs", run_id, stamp)
            os.makedirs(self.dir, exist_ok=True)
        self.logger = logging.getLogger(f"ia_pp.{run_id}.{stamp}")
        self.logger.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
        self.logger.propagate = False
        fh = logging.FileHandler(os.path.join(self.dir, "run.log"), encoding="utf-8")
        fh.setLevel(logging.DEBUG)
        fh.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(levelname)-7s %(message)s"))
        ch = logging.StreamHandler(sys.stdout)
        ch.setLevel(getattr(logging, level, logging.INFO))
        ch.setFormatter(logging.Formatter("%(asctime)s %(message)s", "%H:%M:%S"))
        self.logger.addHandler(fh)
        self.logger.addHandler(ch)
        self._err = open(os.path.join(self.dir, "errors.jsonl"), "a", encoding="utf-8")
        self._calls = open(os.path.join(self.dir, "llm_calls.jsonl"), "a", encoding="utf-8") if log_llm_calls else None
        self._payloads = open(os.path.join(self.dir, "payloads.jsonl"), "a", encoding="utf-8") if log_payloads else None
        self.codes = Counter()
        self.stage = "setup"
        self.t0 = time.time()

    # ---- plain lines --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def info(self, msg):
        self.logger.info(msg)

    def debug(self, msg):
        self.logger.debug(msg)

    # ---- classified events --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def event(self, code, detail="", echo=True, **ctx):
        """Record a warning / error with its code. echo=False keeps per-pair noise out of the console."""
        self.codes[code] += 1
        rec = {"ts": datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "code": code,
               "title": ERRORS[code].title if code in ERRORS else "", "stage": self.stage,
               "detail": str(detail)[:2000], **{k: _safe(v) for k, v in ctx.items()}}
        try:
            self._err.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            self._err.flush()
        except Exception:
            pass
        line = f"[{code}] {rec['title']}: {str(detail)[:500]}" + (f" | {ctx}" if ctx and echo else "")
        if echo:
            (self.logger.warning if code.startswith("W") else self.logger.error)(line)
        else:
            self.logger.debug(line)

    def exception(self, code, exc, **ctx):
        """Unexpected exception: classified event + full traceback in run.log."""
        self.event(code, f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", **ctx)
        self.logger.debug("traceback", exc_info=exc)

    def llm_call(self, **rec):
        if self._calls is None:
            return
        try:
            rec = {"ts": round(time.time(), 3), "stage": self.stage, **{k: _safe(v) for k, v in rec.items()}}
            self._calls.write(json.dumps(rec, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def payload(self, **rec):
        if self._payloads is None:
            return
        try:
            self._payloads.write(json.dumps({k: _safe(v, 10 ** 7) for k, v in rec.items()}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def write_json(self, name, obj):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, name), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                json.dump(obj, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"could not write {name}: {e}")

    def write_yaml(self, name, obj):
        try:
            import yaml
            with open(os.path.join(self.dir, name), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                yaml.safe_dump(obj, f, sort_keys=False, allow_unicode=True)
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"could not write {name}: {e}")

    def close(self):
        for f in (self._err, self._calls, self._payloads):
            try:
                if f:
                    f.flush()
                    f.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
        for h in list(self.logger.handlers):
            try:
                h.flush()
                h.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self.logger.removeHandler(h)


def _safe(v, limit=2000):
    if v is None or isinstance(v, (bool, int, float)):
        return v
    s = str(v)
    return s if len(s) <= limit else s[:limit] + "..."

#### END FILE ####
#### FILE: ia_policy_procedure/ia_pp/outputs.py | sha256=7a39eeb198c94c2258c33bbfa9ac836e65b6da0b0372ccc076b34f3f2cb6641c ####
"""Result files (same content and column names as the validated notebook):

  ia_pp_pairs.parquet              every (alert, document) read, with decision, status, score, sections, quotes
  ia_pp_impacted_sections.parquet  one row per impacted section / sub-section
  ia_pp_alert_impacts.jsonl        one JSON per alert (impacted / possible / scope review, with sections)
  ia_pp_results_summary.xlsx       How to read | summary | per alert | by scope | framework documents | document scope
  production/                      the exact prompts, schemas and settings used (run record)
"""
import os
import json
import math
import shutil

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from .io_utils import write_parquet, write_text, write_json
from .rules import quote_found

SHOWN = ["IMPACTED", "POSSIBLE_IMPACT", "SCOPE_REVIEW"]
PAIR_COLUMNS = ["RECORD_ID", "alert_title", "DOC_TYPE", "DOC_ID", "doc_title", "doc_scope", "doc_applicability",
                "document_role", "search_rank", "model_decision", "final_decision", "impact_status", "confidence_tier",
                "link_score", "decision_prob", "confidence_level", "impact_type", "change_needed", "linked_sections",
                "linked_units", "reasoning", "evidence_from_alert", "evidence_from_target", "grounding_flag",
                "section_grounded", "framework_change", "error_code", "error_detail", "run_id"]


def _j(v):
    return None if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and math.isnan(v)) else v


def write_results(s, ctx, res, prompts, log, usage_report):
    out = s.output_dir
    titles = dict(zip(ctx.alerts.alert, ctx.alerts.title))
    r = res.copy()
    r["doc_applicability"] = r.doc.map(ctx.doc_applic).fillna("")
    r["doc_title"] = r.doc.map(ctx.doc_title)
    r["alert_title"] = r.alert.map(titles)
    r["linked_sections"] = r.linked_units.fillna("").map(
        lambda u: " | ".join(ctx.unit_info[x]["gpps_label"] for x in str(u).split("; ") if x in ctx.unit_info))
    r["run_id"] = s.run_id
    pairs = r.rename(columns={"alert": "RECORD_ID", "doc": "DOC_ID", "doc_type": "DOC_TYPE"})
    for c in PAIR_COLUMNS:
        if c not in pairs.columns:
            pairs[c] = None
    pairs = pairs[PAIR_COLUMNS]
    write_parquet(pairs, os.path.join(out, "ia_pp_pairs.parquet"))

    srows = []
    for p in pairs[pairs.impact_status.isin(SHOWN)].itertuples():
        for u in str(p.linked_units or "").split("; "):
            if u in ctx.unit_info:
                I = ctx.unit_info[u]
                srows.append(dict(RECORD_ID=p.RECORD_ID, DOC_TYPE=p.DOC_TYPE, DOC_ID=p.DOC_ID, doc_title=p.doc_title,
                                  doc_scope=p.doc_scope, impact_status=p.impact_status, unit_id=u,
                                  section_no=I["section_no"], section_title=I["section_title"],
                                  subsection_no=I["subsection_no"], subsection_title=I["subsection_title"],
                                  gpps_label=I["gpps_label"], quote_in_this_section=quote_found(p.evidence_from_target, I["text"]),
                                  impact_type=p.impact_type, link_score=p.link_score, change_needed=p.change_needed))
    write_parquet(pd.DataFrame(srows, columns=["RECORD_ID", "DOC_TYPE", "DOC_ID", "doc_title", "doc_scope", "impact_status",
                                               "unit_id", "section_no", "section_title", "subsection_no", "subsection_title",
                                               "gpps_label", "quote_in_this_section", "impact_type", "link_score",
                                               "change_needed"]),
                  os.path.join(out, "ia_pp_impacted_sections.parquet"))

    def items(g):
        return [{"doc_id": x.DOC_ID, "title": x.doc_title, "scope": x.doc_scope, "role": x.document_role,
                 "impact_status": x.impact_status, "confidence_tier": x.confidence_tier,
                 "link_score": None if pd.isna(x.link_score) else int(x.link_score),
                 "impact_type": _j(x.impact_type), "change_needed": _j(x.change_needed),
                 "sections": [{k: ctx.unit_info[u][k] for k in ("section_no", "section_title", "subsection_no",
                                                                "subsection_title", "gpps_label")}
                              for u in str(x.linked_units or "").split("; ") if u in ctx.unit_info],
                 "section_grounded": bool(x.section_grounded) if x.section_grounded is not None else False,
                 "evidence_from_alert": _j(x.evidence_from_alert), "evidence_from_target": _j(x.evidence_from_target),
                 "reasoning": _j(x.reasoning)}
                for x in g.sort_values("link_score", ascending=False).itertuples()]

    shown = pairs[pairs.impact_status.isin(SHOWN)]
    lines = []
    for a in ctx.alerts.alert:
        g = shown[shown.RECORD_ID == a]
        sel = lambda st, t: g[(g.impact_status == st) & (g.DOC_TYPE == t)]
        lines.append(json.dumps({
            "record_id": a, "alert_title": titles.get(a), "run_id": s.run_id,
            "counts": {st.lower(): {t: int(((g.impact_status == st) & (g.DOC_TYPE == t)).sum())
                                    for t in ("policy", "procedure")} for st in SHOWN},
            "impacted": {"policies": items(sel("IMPACTED", "policy")), "procedures": items(sel("IMPACTED", "procedure"))},
            "possible_impact": {"policies": items(sel("POSSIBLE_IMPACT", "policy")),
                                "procedures": items(sel("POSSIBLE_IMPACT", "procedure"))},
            "scope_review": items(g[g.impact_status == "SCOPE_REVIEW"])}, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
    write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", os.path.join(out, "ia_pp_alert_impacts.jsonl"))

    n_alerts = len(ctx.alerts)
    summary = []
    for kind in ("policy", "procedure"):
        pk = pairs[pairs.DOC_TYPE == kind]
        imp, pos = pk[pk.impact_status == "IMPACTED"], pk[pk.impact_status == "POSSIBLE_IMPACT"]
        both = pk[pk.impact_status.isin(["IMPACTED", "POSSIBLE_IMPACT"])]
        summary.append(dict(doc_type=kind, pairs_read=len(pk), no_answer=int((pk.final_decision == "ERROR").sum()),
                            impacted=len(imp), impacted_per_alert=round(len(imp) / max(n_alerts, 1), 1),
                            alerts_with_impacted=imp.RECORD_ID.nunique(), possible_impact=len(pos),
                            possible_per_alert=round(len(pos) / max(n_alerts, 1), 1),
                            alerts_with_any=both.RECORD_ID.nunique(),
                            scope_review=int((pk.impact_status == "SCOPE_REVIEW").sum()),
                            framework_links=int((both.document_role == "FRAMEWORK").sum()),
                            change_required_pct=round(100 * both.impact_type.astype(str).eq("CHANGE_REQUIRED").mean(), 1)
                            if len(both) else np.nan,
                            section_grounded_pct=round(100 * both.section_grounded.astype(str).eq("True").mean(), 1)
                            if len(both) else np.nan))
    summary = pd.DataFrame(summary)
    log.info("RESULTS " + s.run_id + f" | {n_alerts} alerts | IMPACTED = link_score >= {s.rules['headline_min_score']} | "
             f"POSSIBLE_IMPACT = {s.rules['link_threshold']}-{s.rules['headline_min_score'] - 1}\n"
             + summary.to_string(index=False))

    try:
        by_scope = shown.groupby(["DOC_TYPE", "doc_scope", "impact_status"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).reset_index()
        per_alert = shown.pivot_table(index="RECORD_ID", columns=["DOC_TYPE", "impact_status"], values="DOC_ID",
                                      aggfunc="count", fill_value=0) if len(shown) else pd.DataFrame()
        if len(per_alert):
            per_alert.columns = [f"{a}_{b.lower()}" for a, b in per_alert.columns]
        per_alert = per_alert.reindex(ctx.alerts.alert, fill_value=0).rename_axis("RECORD_ID").reset_index()
        per_alert.insert(1, "alert_title", per_alert.RECORD_ID.map(titles))
        fw = pairs[pairs.document_role == "FRAMEWORK"].groupby(["DOC_ID", "doc_title"]).agg(
            pairs_read=("RECORD_ID", "size"), model_linked=("model_decision", lambda x: int((x == "LINKED").sum())),
            process_change_required=("impact_status", lambda x: int(x.isin(["IMPACTED", "POSSIBLE_IMPACT"]).sum()))
        ).reset_index()
        errs = pairs[pairs.final_decision == "ERROR"].groupby(["DOC_TYPE", "error_code"]).size().rename("pairs").reset_index()
        with pd.ExcelWriter(os.path.join(out, "ia_pp_results_summary.xlsx")) as xl:
            pd.DataFrame({"How to read": [
                f"Run {s.run_id}: every policy read for every alert; procedures = search top {s.search['proc_top_k']} per "
                "alert, each read in full. ONE model call per (alert, document).",
                f"IMPACTED = model LINKED with link_score >= {s.rules['headline_min_score']} and both verbatim quotes "
                "verified by code.",
                f"POSSIBLE_IMPACT = model LINKED with link_score {s.rules['link_threshold']}-"
                f"{s.rules['headline_min_score'] - 1}, quotes verified - SME review queue.",
                f"SCOPE_REVIEW = linked to another country's LOCAL document: a {s.country['name']} alert should not "
                "impact it unless that country adopts the requirement.",
                "Framework / process documents count only when the alert requires the process itself to change.",
                "no_answer / sheet 'pairs without answer': re-run the same command to retry them (see error codes)."]}
            ).to_excel(xl, sheet_name="How to read", index=False)
            summary.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="summary", index=False)
            per_alert.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="per alert", index=False)
            by_scope.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="by scope", index=False)
            fw.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="framework documents", index=False)
            errs.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="pairs without answer", index=False)
            ctx.scope.to_excel(xl, sheet_name="document scope", index=False)
    except Exception as e:
        log.event("W-OUT-001", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}")

    # run record: exact prompts, schemas, exceptions and (masked) settings
    prod = os.path.join(out, "production")
    os.makedirs(prod, exist_ok=True)
    for key, (ppath, spath) in prompts.files.items():
        for src in (ppath, spath):
            try:
                shutil.copy2(src, os.path.join(prod, os.path.basename(src)))
            except OSError as e:
                log.event("E-OUT-001", f"copy {src}: {e}")
    write_json({"run_id": s.run_id, "country": s.country_code, "country_name": s.country["name"],
                "n_alerts": n_alerts, "rules": s.rules, "search": s.search, "model": {k: v for k, v in s.model.items()},
                "framework_documents": ctx.framework_docs, "skipped_documents": ctx.skip_docs,
                "sources": ctx.sources_used, "usage": usage_report,
                "calls": "ONE per (alert, document) - no audit call in production"},
               os.path.join(prod, "production_config.json"))
    return summary

#### END FILE ####
